BG shall not bear any interest and is liable to be forfeited for unsatisfactory completio n or an abandonment of the supply. Note: If successful bidder did not remit SD within 14 days of receipt of order, Penalty of 10% per annu m shall be levied for delayed remittance of security deposit. 6) Purchase Preference is given as specified in bid.
